recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆雙葉中性球，箭頭所指細胞質邊緣有一小塊淡藍色、邊界模糊的斑塊，就是杜勒小體；細胞質顆粒細緻、無空泡，缺乏毒性顆粒。
features: Single mature neutrophil with bilobed nucleus and clumped chromatin
Small, ill-defined pale blue cytoplasmic inclusion at the cell periphery (arrow)
Remaining cytoplasm pale with fine specific granules; no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Surrounding red cells overlap in a thick region; a few platelets present
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus. At the cytoplasmic periphery there is a small, poorly demarcated pale blue patch consistent with a Döhle body, representing retained rough endoplasmic reticulum. No toxic granulation or cytoplasmic vacuolization is identified. Findings are consistent with a Döhle body without toxic changes.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, sharper and present in most neutrophils together with macrothrombocytopenia.
A platelet or precipitate is granular or purple and sharply outlined, whereas a Döhle body is a homogeneous pale blue cytoplasmic zone.
Pelger-Huët refers to bilobed nuclei with coarse chromatin in most neutrophils, a nuclear rather than cytoplasmic finding; this cell's feature of interest is the cytoplasmic inclusion.
